headline: GTA 6 PC recompilation project shut down after takedown notice
summary: Project Leonida, a fan effort to bring GTA 6's console build to PC, was shut down and its Discord and GitHub servers taken offline, with its 15-year-old creator banned until 2028. Outlets differ on which party is responsible, naming either Rockstar or publisher Take-Two.

claims.statement: Project Leonida, a fan effort to bring GTA 6's console build to PC, was shut down, taking its Discord and GitHub servers offline.

sources.quote: Project Leonida, a recompilation project aiming to bring the console version of GTA 6 to the PC, has shut down with its Discord and GitHub servers offline
Leonida, a fan project by 15-year-old "NotRexed," has vanished after a DMCA takedown notice from GTA VI publisher Take-Two.

claims.statement: The project's creator, a 15-year-old, was banned from the project's own Discord until 2028.

sources.quote: its creator is now banned from the former until 2028

discrepancies.explanation: The outlets attribute the takedown to different parties: Tom's Hardware's headline names Rockstar, while The Verge says the DMCA notice came from publisher Take-Two.

quotes.quote: Rockstar nukes 15-year-old’s GTA 6 recompilation project, Discord and GitHub servers taken down
a DMCA takedown notice from GTA VI publisher Take-Two
